div.h1: Send your first event in under five minutes.

p.class: text-monochrome-plus2 m-0 max-w-[480px] font-sans text-base leading-relaxed

div.p: Amplitude's docs cover everything from your first track() call to cohort-targeted experiments at scale. Pick a stack, copy the snippet, and go.
